metadata.title: On Compact Hermitian Surfaces With Positive Strominger-Bismut Sectional Curvature
metadata.abstract: In an earlier work, Yau and Zheng proposed a Hermitian analogue of a weak form of the Frankel conjecture, which states that any compact Hermitian manifold with positive Strominger-Bismut sectional curvature must be biholomorphic to the complex projective space. In this article, we confirm the conjecture in complex dimension two. This is achieved by a vanishing theorem for anti-self-dual harmonic 2-forms on such surfaces, utilizing a curvature decomposition formula by Ferreira and a refined Kato inequality.

analysis.workSummary: 作者证明具有正 Strominger–Bismut 截面曲率的紧 Hermitian 曲面双全纯于 CP2。
techniques: 反自对偶调和二形式消失
analysis.breakthrough: 若论证成立，将确认相关猜想在复维数二的情形。
analysis.limitations: 结论限于紧 Hermitian 曲面及指定联络曲率；不可替换为任意联络或高维结果。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。未见 AI 协作声明仅指这些已检查来源，不代表已核验整篇论文完全由人类完成。
analysis.priorityReason: 正曲率到复结构刚性的结论强，技术可与其他消失定理比较。
